evidence.claim: Players may value competence, a clear free retry and control over optional ads. No player evidence collected.
evidence.validation: Observe rule/reward comprehension, independent retries, declines and return to play in consented pilot sessions.

evidence.claim: All pilot account IDs, markets and observations are synthetic; there are no market/revenue estimates.
evidence.validation: Replace with dated, scoped evidence from the actual target game; retain source, method and limits.

player.audience: Assumed adult casual players; actual audience/age eligibility must be researched.
motives: Hypothesis: learn a mechanic and feel progress.
player.session_context: Unknown; measure actual session context rather than assigning a genre duration.
fairness_risks: Do not manufacture failure to sell a rescue; clarify purchase/no-ads promises.

monetization.value_hypothesis: Optional assistance and clear no-ads value may suit this hypothetical loop.
monetization.free_path: Retry without payment or accepting an ad.
monetization.no_ads_scope: Remove involuntary ads; explicitly disclose any retained optional rewarded offers.

levels.learning_intent: Introduce one mechanic, provide safe practice, then observe independent use.
levels.fail_recovery: Explain the reason, allow free retry and observe comprehension.

measurement.primary_metric: Observed comprehension of the learning/offer task; no population uplift claim.
experience_guardrails: Confusion, fail-to-leave, ad-to-return, regret, complaints and technical defects.
revenue_guardrails: Verified revenue only; currency/unit/fees/refunds and test traffic kept explicit.
measurement.decision_rule: Use deterministic contract tests for this fixture; game experiments require actual baseline, sample/power and preregistered guardrail margins. No revenue result is inferred.
